story_type: vehicle trapped in breaking waves during a hurricane, swimmer and basket hoist
hook: Hurricane Ike was closing in. A vehicle was stuck in the waves.
narration: Hurricane Ike was closing in on Galveston, and a vehicle was trapped in the water.
This was one of the first rescue missions of the storm, flown by a Coast Guard crew from Air Station Houston.
Waves were breaking around the vehicle as the rescue swimmer rode the cable down.
He reached the vehicle and got the survivor ready while the basket came down.
From the cockpit the pilot cannot see straight down, so the flight mechanic at the door talks him into position.
[short pause] The basket came up over the breaking waves with the survivor inside.
outcome: The crew brought the survivor into the helicopter, then hoisted their rescue swimmer back up.
title: Hurricane Ike rescue from the waves
description:
During Hurricane Ike on Sept. 12, 2008, a Coast Guard HH-65C crew from Air Station Houston lowered a rescue swimmer to a vehicle trapped in the water near Galveston, Texas, and hoisted a survivor aboard.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Houston, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/45655/helicopter-rescue-mission
